pollingInterval.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollingInterval.description: How often to check for updates (30-300 seconds, default: 60)

escapeAlertType.title: Escape Alert Type
escapeAlertType.description: How escape alerts appear in HomeKit

ignoredPets.title: Ignored Pets
ignoredPets.description: List of pet names to ignore (will not create HomeKit accessories or poll for updates)

escapeConfirmations.title: Escape Confirmations
escapeConfirmations.description: Consecutive 'out of zone' readings required before escape alert (1 = immediate, 2 = balanced, 3 = conservative)

escapeCheckInterval.title: Escape Check Interval (seconds)
escapeCheckInterval.description: How quickly to re-check when potential escape detected (faster than normal polling)

offlineAlertMinutes.title: Collar Offline Alert (minutes)
offlineAlertMinutes.description: How long the collar must be offline before alerting. Leave alert type blank to disable.

offlineAlertType.title: Collar Offline Alert Type
offlineAlertType.description: How collar offline alerts appear in HomeKit. Leave blank to disable.

layout.title: Ignored Pets
layout.description: Add pet names to exclude from HomeKit (e.g., 'Charlie')
